SELECT pb.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fb_pixels p WHERE p.pixel_bm_id = pb.id) AS pixel_count FROM fb_pixel_bms pb
pb.owner_id = #{ownerId} AND pb.deleted_at IS NULL
AND (pb.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search}, '%') OR pb.bm_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search}, '%'))
AND pb.status = #{status}
ORDER BY pb.created_at DESC
